reviews.title: Broken within just two months of use.
reviews.comment: Ordered this to replace my factory 2070s, which only came with a single fan. The dual fans honestly seem to work harder and make more noise than the single output. Not only was this system underperforming, but it only lasted two months. TWO. One minute I’m setting up OBS, configuring settings and whatnot, then the next I am suddenly prompted into “GeForce Experience,” stating to me that the new graphics card will only be able to continue operating by updating to the latest driver. So I did. Ever since then, my PC has become a complete nightmare. Constantly cutting out at random times, a pixilated monitor that literally has taken shape of a pac-man level. At least 75% of visibility is now gone. Oh, and forget about running ANY type of program. Literally everything crashes. I’m hopeful that customer service will rectify this and sort things out…
reviews.author: Mater

reviews.title: A cool running BEAST!
reviews.comment: This was an ASUS reman unit that came wrapped simply in a mylar anti-static bag and bubble wrapped. It looks like new except for a small smudge. The best part is this GPU is obviously over engineered. It's based on the 2080 template and stock clock speed is 90 MHz higher than the 2080 but this ASUS 2070 Super is already overclocked to 1845 AND it can be over-overclocked to over 2100 MHz! This thing is a beast. I really lucked out cuz it's for my 16  year old son as an upgrade from his AMD RX 590 Fatboy. It did very well on 1080p but this 2070 Super has over 100% it's performance and draws less power! It stays cool no problem and is quiet. I got lucky. Yay me.
